svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: compares the query to every single vector
perfect, and linear in the corpus
starts high, hops toward the query, drops a layer
touches a few hundred, not a hundred million
The one knob at query time is efSearch, the size of the candidate list.
Bigger means better recall and more latency. That is the whole tradeoff.
Give up two results out of a hundred, get a thousand times the speed
A reranker runs on the results anyway, which is why approximate retrieval is almost always the right trade.
